approval.note: Drafted by the implementing agent. Not approved. Only the user may approve or change thresholds.

scope_note: The evaluator is deterministic. These gates check the evaluation gate itself on the reference stack with a scripted, keyword-driven model; they say nothing about whether a real prompt or change is better.

verdict_agreement.measure: cases whose outcome (passed, failed with a reason, refused with a code, or the selected case list) equals the hand-written expectation

harmful_candidate_detection.measure: approved candidates that change behaviour and are evaluated as failed

unreviewed_evaluation_refusal.measure: pending, rejected, or never-reviewed subjects that are refused evaluation

selection_agreement.measure: affected-case selections equal to the hand-written case lists

full_suite_coverage.measure: evaluations that ran the golden, triage, proposal, and dbt full suites plus a targeted run

approved_threshold_only.measure: passing verdicts whose every suite rests on approved thresholds

fail_closed.measure: protected-file changes and unapproved-threshold suites that produce a failed verdict

protected_file_writes.measure: changes to goldens, thresholds, the case index, the runtime prompt, registry contracts, or the manifest during the run

determinism.measure: re-evaluations that return the identical recorded evaluation without a new row

not_measured.candidate_quality: the scripted model ignores instruction text before the request, so a prompt's real effect on answers is not measured
not_measured.live_traffic: shadow and canary behaviour belongs to ADS-057
